sandevistan.screen.howto: Craft the Sandevistan, then talk to a Ripperdoc in a village clinic: implanting costs 8 emeralds and 3 hearts of damage.
sandevistan.screen.fx.1: Slows your surroundings by 85% (you move normally).
sandevistan.screen.fx.3: Strength, Haste, Night Vision, no fall damage, 50% dodge
sandevistan.screen.fx.4: Afterimages and a green tint while active
sandevistan.tooltip.immuno.1: +20 Mind for 1 minute (stacks, up to 100 total Mind)
sandevistan.tooltip.immuno.2: Lowers cyberpsychosis by up to 40; when it ends the Mind bonus goes away, you lose 5 Mind for good per dose and part of the cyberpsychosis comes back. Hold sneak and hit another player to inject it into them. Using several in a row (within 3 minutes) makes it weaker.
sandevistan.mindzero: Your Mind hit 0%! It hurts (3 hearts), and using it now costs 2 hearts every 8 s of use while cyberpsychosis keeps building.
sandevistan.psy.on: The cyberpsychosis symptoms are setting in...
sandevistan.psy.limit: CYBERPSYCHOSIS AT 100%! It can still go higher.
sandevistan.remedy.used: You took the Neural Stabilizer: +5 Mind and Good Mind for 1 minute.
sandevistan.remedy.noimplant: You do not have a Sandevistan implanted.
sandevistan.tooltip.stabilizer.1: Heals 5 Mind right away and gives Good Mind for 1 minute
sandevistan.tooltip.stabilizer.2: With Good Mind, each second has a 1% chance to heal 1 Mind, and it lowers cyberpsychosis
sandevistan.immuno.used: Immunosuppressant: +%s Mind (total bonus +%s) and -%s cyberpsychosis for now.
sandevistan.immuno.full: Your Mind is already at 100. The Immunosuppressant has no effect.
sandevistan.immuno.end: The Immunosuppressant wore off: you lost the bonus and %s Mind for good, and %s cyberpsychosis came back.
